title: Profile main gate
statement: Let $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ be finite, let $a\colon\mathbb{N}\to\{−1,1\}$ be a sign sequence, and let $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. Define a Boolean function on $\{−1,1\}^n$ as follows: if $a(i+1)=a(i)$, it is constantly $1$; otherwise, if $a(i+1)=1$, it is the gate that outputs $1$ when at least $i+1$ coordinates in $S$ are positive and $−1$ otherwise; if $a(i+1)=−1$, it outputs $−1$ when at least $i+1$ coordinates in $S$ are positive and $1$ otherwise.
